text:
claire_cs: Heads up — Paxion Health (acct 9990) invoice #9320 autopay failed 4x. Gateway returns `expired_card` on first attempt then `card_declined` afterwards. Customer says the corporate card expired end of month and their admin will update card today. They asked if we can hold access until card updated.

dennis_fin: Share last4 and times. If card was expired we can pause retries and send a secure pay link for card update. If they promise to update today, we can hold access or grant limited access depending on product policy.

claire_cs: last4 1122. Attempts: 2026-04-18T08:01Z (`expired_card`), 08:15Z (`card_declined`), 09:02Z (`card_declined`), 11:30Z (`card_declined`). PO on file: PO-6000. Customer msg: "Card expired, corporate admin will update by EOD. Can you give us a short grace period? We'll update card and authorize payment."

arya_billing: For expired card cases we usually: 1) pause auto-retries, 2) create a one-time secure card update/paylink, 3) add a 48h grace flag for onboarding customers. We can waive late fees when card updated within window. Need CS to attach the customer's confirmation to the ticket.

billing-bot: [automated] Payment log: invoice=9320 customer=PaxionHealth attempts=4 status=failed gateway=stripe region=us-east-1

leo_sales: Sales requests limited access unlocked so onboarding isn't blocked. Recommend 48h grace and send paylink. Also ask CS to remind them to include invoice ref when confirming.

dennis_fin: Approved: create paylink (amount=invoice_total) and set account_hold=grace_48h. Disable automatic card retries while grace flag is active. If card not updated in 48h, schedule churn-ops to suspend account and escalate.

claire_cs: I'll send paylink and note grace period. Messaging to customer: "Thanks — we paused retries. Please update card using the secure link we sent and include Invoice 9320 / PO-6000 in the description. Well waive the late fee if payment completes within 48 hours."

arya_billing: Creating ticket BILL-5401 for invoice 9320 (expired card — paylink + 48h grace). Please attach paylink click receipt and card auth once completed.

claire_cs: Customer replied: "Thanks — admin confirmed they will update card within 6 hours. We'll use the secure link." I'll attach confirmation to the ticket when I have it.

dennis_fin: Good. Action items: arya_billing create paylink & ticket (done), claire_cs attach customer confirmation and monitor. Finance to reconcile once payment settles. Escalate if not cleared after 48h.
